newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Three PC makers started as buys.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Three PC makers started as buys.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analysts Daniel Kuntsler and Rahul Narang started coverage Tuesday of personal computer makers Compaq Computer Corp, Dell Computer Corp and Gateway 2000 Inc with ratings of buy.
-- "Gateway 2000 has done a remarkable job of broadening its appeal," they wrote. "... We believe GATE still has room for appreciation to our 12-month price target of $75."
-- "We believe Dell has honed and brilliantly executed a business model that emphasizes operating margins and trims asset exposure." Kuntsler and Narang set a 12-month price target of $90.
-- "Investors should play Compaq's pre-eminence in indirect selling with both PCs and servers." They set a 12-month price target of $90 a share.
-- Shares in Gateway opened down one to 55-7/8, and Dell was down 5/8 to 73-1/8. Compaq was down 1/4 to 76.
